== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page, drafted from old Players Committee forum posts.

=== Sources used ===
* Players Committee forum topic 4273, "January 8th 2005.  Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier", posts 58673, 59872, 58970, 59501, 59387, 60259 (refs <code>pcf-4273-…</code>).
* Players Committee 2004/2005 events listing (ref <code>pc-events05</code>, reused from [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]).

=== Missing data ===
* Whether the final confrontation was played is not reported.

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The 27 December 2004 announcement dates the event "January 8th, 2004"; every other post and the topic title give 8 January 2005.
* Lingrell labelled each player's first deck Light Side and second Dark Side, but Pistone's correction shows his two were the other way round, and Konsker's AOBS (Dark) and QMC with Ellors (Light) are also reversed. The table keeps the posted order and records and does not assign sides.
* The two qualifiers finished third and fourth. The List's Kashyyyk Regional row already gives Day 2 byes to Pistone and Hollingworth, which would explain why the byes passed down, but no post says so.

=== Marginal cuts ===
* Lingrell's personal email address (privacy); travel advice, trading and poker details; the opponent numbers for each game.

=== Build notes ===
* Title follows [[2004 New Jersey Open Qualifier]]; the List row calls it "Neutral Ground Open". A redirect from "2005 NYC Open Qualifier" is drafted.
